description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing UI state in a React application, including theme toggling, sidebar visibility, and modal states.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Toggle between dark and light themes, updating localStorage and document attributes.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Set the theme explicitly to 'light' or 'dark', updating localStorage and document attributes.

methods.name: toggleSidebar
methods.description: Toggle the sidebar open or closed.

methods.name: openModal
methods.description: Open a specific modal identified by its name.
